title: The Polar Express
tagline: All aboard. Hot chocolate is served.
about: On Christmas Eve, a boy who's starting to doubt boards a magical train to the North Pole.

Polar Express Dining CarThe Polar ExpressAll aboard. Hot chocolate is served.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPolar Express turkey and cranberry rollsWarm rolls with roast turkey, brie, cranberry sauce and spinachHow to make it8 soft dinner rolls8 tbsp cranberry sauce300g roast turkey, sliced150g brie, sliced1 handful of baby spinach8 paper tickets, hole punchedHeat the oven to 180°C. Split the rolls and spread the bases with cranberry sauce.Layer with turkey, brie and spinach and close.Wrap each in foil and warm until the cheese softens.Unwrap and rewrap in baking paper with a paper ticket tucked in.MainsNorth Pole chicken pot pieCreamy chicken and vegetable pie under golden puff pastryHow to make it600g chicken thigh, diced2 tbsp vegetable oil1 onion, diced2 carrots, diced2 celery sticks, diced1 tbsp plain flour300ml thickened cream1 tsp dried thyme1 cup peas1 sheet of puff pastry1 egg, beatenBrown the chicken in the oil.Add the onion, carrots and celery and soften.Stir in the flour, cream, thyme and peas and simmer until thick.Pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and egg wash.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Christmas Eve meatballs in cranberry glazeChristmas Eve at home before the train arrivesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and nutmeg, baked and tossed in a sticky cranberry, chilli and soy glaze, over buttery mash with chives.Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 egg, 30g parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg and salt.Roll into 28 balls and bake at 200°C for 18 minutes.Simmer 250g cranberry sauce, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and a pinch of chilli for 5 minutes, then toss the meatballs through.Serve over mash with snipped chives.SweetsSleigh bell sugar cookiesBell-shaped sugar cookies with white icing, silver pearls and a red ribbonHow to make it200g butter, softened150g caster sugar300g plain flour250g icing sugar1 tbsp silver cachous1 drop red food colouringHeat the oven to 180°C. Beat the butter and sugar, then mix in the flour.Chill, roll and cut into bell shapes.Bake and cool.Ice white with icing sugar and water.Press in cachous and pipe a red ribbon with tinted icing.Golden ticket shortbreadButtery shortbread cut like tickets, finished with sugar and gold sprinklesHow to make it250g butter, softened80g icing sugar350g plain flour2 tbsp caster sugar1 tbsp gold sprinklesHeat the oven to 160°C and line trays. Beat the butter and icing sugar, then mix in the flour to a soft dough.Roll out and cut into ticket rectangles.Punch a hole in each with a straw.Bake until pale golden.Sprinkle with caster sugar and gold sprinkles while warm.DrinksThe hot chocolateDark and milk chocolate melted into milk and cream, poured high so it frothsHow to make it750ml milk250ml thickened cream100g dark chocolate, chopped100g milk chocolate, chopped4 tbsp whipped creamHeat the milk and cream until steaming.Whisk in the chocolate until thick and smooth.Pour from a height into mugs so it froths.Top each with whipped cream.
